result.title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
result.summary: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Adaptive DHiSparse 这一长上下文服务系统：在分层稀疏 KV 之上支持 DSpark、DFlash2 等投机解码，并按负载自适应决定哪些 KV 常驻 GPU、哪些按需从主机精确融合检索，从而提升吞吐与并发。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按负载选择 KV 驻留与逐出、并以精确检索补回缺失行的机制，可作为核查「高负载或缓存受限时视觉 token 证据是否被保留在可访问状态」的线索；投机解码的提议—验证流程或可供参考 latent 轨迹的验证思路，但联系属推测，需核查原文。
